trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Checked deployment history** for checkout-api: v2.3.1 (latest production deploy) was unhealthy; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back all production regions** (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to **v2.3.0** — the rollback completed and was verified (`VERIFIED`).
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) documenting the health check failures after v2.3.1, the rollback to v2.3.0, and that on-call was paged for follow-up investigation of v2.3.1.

Note: No change-manager approval was needed since v2.3.0 was already healthy in production.
